en: "...If only I could sing in that voice{w}just one more time, I thought.{w}...I humbly ask this of you."{w}
note: Standalone copy of the last page of row 1359 (Arlotte asks the party to fetch the plant from the Giaf Dunes).

en: "Adventurers! Thank you so much!{w}So that is the fruit's flesh!!"{w}{p}"You have my heartfelt thanks!{w}If I eat this, that voice of mine will once again..."{w}

"......You went to all the trouble of picking it for me, but{w}I'm sorry."{w}{p}"If I were to eat this,{w}it would mean denying{w}my entire life as a singer up to now."{w}{p}"Every day I remembered the voice I used to have,{w}and longed to have that voice again..."{w}{p}"That is what I thought, but{w}holding this in my hands,
I have realized my mistake."{w}
note: Branch: Arlotte declines to eat the fruit. Rows 1361 and 1362 are alternative reactions.

en:
"Travelers of the highway,{w}if you are not in a hurry,"{w}{p}"please enjoy the voice of Arlotte,
the seasoned songstress!"{w}
note: Kaidou = the highway (cf. row 1350 "the finest songstress on the highway"). Jukuren no utahime = "seasoned songstress": she embraces her age, matching row 1363.

en:
"Argh, I need more hands!{w}Why on earth is there so much...!{w}Hmm? You guys... you're adventurers, right?"{w}{p}"Perfect timing! Please!{w}Won't you help us keep the peace
here in Teridon!?"{w}{p}"By rights, the guards should be handling all of it,
but we just don't have the manpower."{w}{p}"If worrying about shame kept the peace,
we patrolmen wouldn't be needed at all.{w}Please, take this on."{w}{p}"I'm Molder, Captain of the Guard.
Glad to be working with you."{w}
note: Haji de chian ga mamoreru nara...: Molder means he is not too proud to ask outsiders for help; kept the "shame" image. Keibiheichou = Captain of the Guard.

en:
"Here in Teridon, a town whose chief
is Barjeff, the Evangelist of Love..."{w}
note: Fragment leading into row 1367; trailing "..." added since the sentence continues there. Barjeff-shi rendered via his post (chief) to avoid a gendered "Mr."
The source writes the "DE" particle in capitals as a gag; mirrored with a capitalised "BY". "...and" joins on from row 1366.

en: "Violence is the last resort!{w}First, you hit them with a passionate heart!"{w}{p}"...That said, we're short on people.{w}Chief Barjeff, show the guard some love already!{w}
note: Source "kudasatto~" read as a garbled "kudasai yo~" (a plea for more support/funding). Row has no closing quote: it is cut off and repeated in row 1369.
Echo of the last page of row 1368, with its {w} turned into \n as in the source. Molder breaks off to bark orders at his men.

en:
"Hey, has anyone gone out to District Two?{w}Hurry! Anyone will do! Go! Run!{w}Phew............hm?"{w}{p}"Oh, it's you guys.{w}Haha............as you can see, this is how things are."{w}{p}"Too few people for way more cases than we can handle.{w}We get new recruits, but their training never gets anywhere."{w}{p}"And me, I've got field duty, paperwork,
commanding, and negotiating with the higher-ups. Plus all the odd jobs and my own errands.{w}...I've got a private life too, y'know?"{w}{p}"Honestly, how many jobs am I juggling here, right?{w}..................But y'know what?"{w}{p}"If we're short-handed
and I'm the only one who can do it, then I'll do it.{w}It's that simple."{w}{p}"Besides,
you could say it just shows how lively this town is.{w}Which is exactly why I've got to protect it."{w}
"Whoa, here we go! What is it!? Zonette again!?{w}Take over here, I'll handle this one myself!{w}This time I'm gonna reform Zonette for sure!"{w}{p}"See you guys later!{w}Alllright, let's go!!"{w}
note: Kaishin se(sa)te yaru: the object is left out; the call just named Zonette, so the name is restored (avoids a pronoun, gender not in glossary). Ties in with row 1344 (Zonette says they will only tease Molder from now on).

en: "I'm counting on you with that request."{w}
Make sure you get that request done right, okay?{w}
note: No quote brackets in the source; kept without quotes.

en: "You guys! Man, you've been a real lifesaver!{w}Thanks to you, things have gotten a lot less hectic."{w}{p}"I know what I said the other day, but we were barely holding on...{w}We had mountains of problems, and it was rewarding,{w}but... when it goes on and on like that..."{w}{p}"You helped this town, and you helped me too.{w}I owe you guys one.{w}...Let me thank you again. Thank you."{w}{p}"Next time, let's go grab a bite together.{w}Don't worry, I've got at least that much breathing room............{w}
note: Kono aida wa aa itta ga: refers to row 1370 ("If I'm the only one who can do it, I'll do it"). Last page has no closing quote: it is cut off and repeated in row 1375.
Echo of the last page of row 1374 ({w} -> \n as in the source).

en: "Let's goooo!!"{w}
note: No speaker box; from context this is Molder running off (row 1375).

en:
"Hey there, you guys really helped us out a lot.{w}Thanks to you, we can afford to take on more people
and train them up."{w}{p}"............Training on the job... that is.{w}Hahaha..."{w}
note: Genba kyouiku = on-the-job training: wry joke that the "training" is just throwing recruits into the field.

en: "You guys, did you get that request taken care of?"{w}
Request resolved?
note: Prompt/menu text before a yes/no choice; kept short.

en: "Well, I'm counting on you again."{w}
note: Reply after the player answers no.

en:
"Well done! Just what I'd expect!
If you're up for it, take the next one too, okay?"{w}
Received 2000 GP.{w}
note: Same pattern as slice_03 row 239 ("Received 5000 GP.").

en:
"Hmm... I won't say much, but...
well, I'm counting on you again."{w}
note: Apparently the reply when a request was cleared badly (no reward).

en: "That request's already been resolved, hasn't it?"{w}
"Welcome, adventurers!{w}I am Chief Barjeff!{w}Now, a huuuuuuuug!!!"{w}
note: Bargef/Barjeff (baajefu) romanized as Barjeff -- new name. Shuchou = chief (head of Teridon).

en: You were hugged by Barjeff.{w}
note: Narration; passive keeps the party as the one hugged and avoids a pronoun for Barjeff (gender not in glossary).

en: "Adventurers!{w}You must never... forget love, hmm?{w}Even toward those who oppose you... love."{w}

"If you intend to make use of this town,
there is something important I must tell you.{w}It concerns this town's ordinance."{w}

"That ordinance is 'Love.'{w}In the end, it is love that will save the land.{w}I shall love you, and so you shall love me as well."{w}{p}"That is this town's ordinance.{w}And there is one more thing.{w}This one is advice."{w}
"The simplest way to express love is the hug!{w}Skin-to-skin contact!{w}Come now, let us hug, you and I!!"{w}
"What? You were tricked?{w}Hahahaha, the one who falls for it is at fault too.{w}Now you're one bit wiser, aren't you?"{w}
note: Context of the "trick" not shown in this slice (likely the party fell for the hug offer, or a later Teridon event). Translated literally.

en: "Now listen, love even the wicked.{w}If your love gets through, even the wicked will love you back.{w}But you must not love the sin, hmm?"{w}

"Once a matter is over, that is the end of it.{w}No matter who was involved, or how,
love them."{w}
"In the end, that is what will save the world."{w}

note: Koutei Rianna-dono rendered "the Sovereign, Rianna" to stay gender-neutral: row 949 calls Rianna nyotei (empress), but the glossary lists gender unknown. Switch to "Her Majesty the Empress" if the glossary is updated. The parcel is Barjeff in hiding (slice_14 rows 1049-1056).

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Contraband?{w}
note: Item name is "mitsuyuhin?" (Contraband?) with the question mark part of the name; no closing period so it does not read "?.". Check against the item table name.

en: "We're counting on you."{w}

"Feeling the love every day?{w}Next time I'm planning to ambush Rianna right out of bed --
what do you think of that!"{w}
note: After the parcel fiasco (slice_14 rows 1049-1066) Barjeff is undeterred. Neza'oki wo nerau = target the moment Rianna wakes up.

en: Dealer
note: Speaker label.

en:
"Good day to you,
and welcome to MILL.GP."{w}{p}"My name is Linesman,
and I have the honor of serving
as your dealer."{w}{p}"Our establishment chiefly offers
blackjack for your enjoyment."{w}{p}"Now then,
please take your time and enjoy yourselves."{w}
note: MILL.GP. kept as written (casino name, full-width Latin in source). Rainzuman romanized as Linesman -- new name.

en:
"Good day to you.{w}Thank you most kindly for honoring us
with your visit again today."{w}{p}"All manner of guests visit our establishment,
some of them incognito."{w}{p}"Therefore, should anything at all occur,
however unlikely,
please inform us at once."{w}{p}"We strive to ensure that every guest
can enjoy themselves with peace of mind."{w}{p}"Now then,
please take your time and enjoy yourselves."{w}

"Good day to you.
We have been expecting you all."{w}{p}"For drinks, please ask at the bar counter,
or tell a dealer or any member of staff."{w}{p}"If any of you are underage
or do not care for alcohol,
please let us know."{w}{p}"We have all manner of drinks,
so we shall bring whatever you prefer right away."{w}{p}"Now then,
please take your time and enjoy yourselves."{w}
Nora
note: Speaker label. Nooura romanized as Nora -- new name. Gender: row 1426 has Yuna say she is a girl.

en: Yuna
note: Speaker label (glossary).

en:
"What's up, debuu?
I'm Nora, debuu."{w}
note: Verbal tic debu(u) (lit. "fatty") kept as a romanized sentence-ender: "debu" for debu, "debuu" for the long debuu. Achishi (cutesy first person) rendered plain "I".

en:
"You're a customer, debuu?
Then come this way, debuu."{w}

note: Unknown-speaker name box; the voice is Yuna (named in row 1411).

en: "Oh, welco......{w}
note: Cut off mid-word; repeated in row 1410.

en:
{0E}"Oh, welco......{0F}
-- Nora!?{w}What are you wearing!?"{w}
note: Echo of row 1409. Nante kakkou = "what a state you're in": Nora turns out to be wearing no underwear (row 1412).

en: "Debu?{w}Yuna, is something weird about me, debu?"{w}
note: Yuna-chin (Nora's cutesy nickname) rendered plain "Yuna"; honorific/nickname suffixes are dropped elsewhere in the project.

en: "Oh, for crying out loud! I'm so sorry, customer!{w}Just for a moment!{w}Sorry, but could you please step outside!"{w}{p}"...You have to at least wear panties, okay?"{w}
note: First page is to the customer (party), second page to Nora.

en: "I don't mind, debu."{w}
"Oh, come ON!"{w}
note: Moo~tsu! (exasperated); rendered "Oh, come ON!"

en: "Okaaay, rinsing you off with hot water, debuu.{w}Sploooooooooosh!{w}I can do my own shower, debuu!"{w}{p}"Customer, is there anything you want me to do, debu?{w}My nose can do anything, debuu!"{w}
note: Nora showers the customer with her own nose (a trunk, apparently). Kept "nose" as in the source.

en: "Noraaa?{w}
note: Cut off; repeated in row 1417.

en: "Yuna, you're funny, debu!{w}Oh, the basket's gonna fall, debu?{w}I'll hold it up for you, debuu!"{w}
note: Kago = basket (literal). Possibly a bath basket Yuna is carrying while she panics.

en: "Customer, look the other way! ...Please!{w}Your apron's all flipped up, I'm telling you! Geez!"{w}
note: First sentence to the customer; second to Nora (Nora is wearing an apron and no underwear). "Your" kept without a name since the source has none; the scene makes it Nora's.
Baajefu ojichan = "Uncle Barjeff" (affectionate, not a relative). No sentence end before the third {w} in the source either.

en:
"...Noraaa?{w}Doesn't putting on panties
count as dressing up?"{w}{p}"I'd really like to see you in panties, Nora."{w}
"Yuna doesn't give me pocket money, debu."{w}
"That's not the point!"{w}

"Like I keep telling you, Noraaa!
Panties!"{w}

"Geez, Yuna, you worry way too much
about every little thing, debu?{w}Just take it easy, debuu."{w}

note: "her"/"she" for Nora: Yuna states in this row that Nora is a girl (onna no ko). Starts the panties fetch-quest.

en: "I'm fine without panties, debu?{w}Why do you worry about it so much, Yuna, debu?{w}You should take your panties off too, Yuna, debuu!"{w}

"Whoa, they're huge... these are panties...?{w}But something this big
should fit even Nora!"{w}{p}"Noraaa!"{w}
note: The party hands over the panties they found.

en: "What is it, debu?"{w}
"Nora,{w}panties! P-A-N-T-I-E-S!"{w}
note: Pa-n-tsu spelled out syllable by syllable; rendered as spelling out the word.

en: "...They're not very cute, debuu."{w}
"I'll make them cute for you one of these days,{w}so come on, let's put them on, okay?"{w}
"...Yep, they suit you, they suit you!{w}You look adorable!"{w}
"Debuu."{w}

"Ah, Nora!
Wait, stop a sec!{w}I hear a nasty sound...... Ahh!"{w}
RRRIP-RIP-RIP-RIP!{w}
note: Sound effect (biribiri = tearing cloth).

en: "...They ripped, debu."{w}
"Aww, no! Hmm,{w}I guess even these were too small..."{w}

"It's better with no panties at all, debuu!{w}I don't mind, debuu!"{w}{p}"If you don't wear any either, Yuna,
you won't mind either, debuu!"{w}
